title: Scope configuration
description: Project-level declaration of available scopes for behavioral specs. Optional file — when absent, only the implicit 'generic' scope is available.

scopes.description: Declared scopes beyond the implicit 'generic'. Order is not significant.

id.description: Unique scope identifier. Must be lowercase, starting with a letter, containing only letters/digits/hyphens. Doubles as the directory name under .riglane/specs/.

label.description: Human-readable description of what the scope represents (e.g., 'Payments integration (v2 API)'). Displayed in CLI output and error messages. Optional — defaults to id.

hint.description: Coverage hint: WHAT this scope's specs govern and, ideally, what they do NOT (with where those belong instead) — e.g. 'Payments API protocol, checkout, refunds. NOT: cross-cutting invariants (→ generic), the fulfilment integration (→ another scope).'. Injected into the scope-orientation guidance the engine gives agents at spec_check / spec_authoring steps, and shown by the scope skills. Optional but strongly recommended — the spec skills prompt for it.

default_active_scope.description: Team-level default active scope used when no user override (.riglane/local/active-scope) is present. Must be either 'generic' or an id declared in 'scopes'. Null/omitted means 'generic' is the fallback.
